notes.title: 🔧 Update Demo v0.17 - September Update
notes.content:
[p]🔧 Fixes & Improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]Door sound bug (single & double doors)[/b]
Doors will now play their opening/closing sound only once, restoring immersion and eliminating annoying repeated sounds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toilet sound volume reduced[/b]
The volume of toilet sounds has been lowered to make the environment more comfortable while maintaining realism.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed old note system[/b]
The outdated note system has been removed to streamline gameplay and reduce clutter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collision on a shelf[/b]
A shelf now has proper collision, preventing players from accidentally clipping through it and improving level navigation.[/p][/*][/list][p]➕ Added:[/p][list][*][p][b]Vending Machine[/b]
A new interactive [b]vending machine[/b] has been added. It enriches the environment and lays the groundwork for more interactive props and mechanics in future updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Objective notification in the Library Level[/b]
Players now receive clear objective notifications when progressing through the Library Level, making it easier to follow and complete tasks.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Spectral Protocol - Demo is Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to announce that the [b]Spectral Protocol Demo[/b] is now live!
Enter the first stages of the experiment, uncover the atmosphere of dread, and test your survival skills in both [b]solo[/b] and [b]co-op[/b] mode.[/p][p]This demo will give you a first taste of what awaits:[/p][list][*][p]👥 Play solo or with a friend in 2-player co-op[/p][/*][*][p]🌌 Experience eerie environments filled with tension[/p][/*][*][p]👻 Encounter unsettling entities lurking in the shadows[/p][/*][/list][p]⚡ Don’t forget to [b]wishlist Spectral Protocol[/b] to stay updated on the full release ![/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – August Update
notes.content: [p][b]🧠 Patch Notes – August Update: Smarter AI & Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p][b]New Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Improved Enemy Awareness:[/b] Stone statues now accurately detect and register nearby players via trigger volumes. This ensures more reliable activation and pursuit behavior in multiplayer sessions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Universal AI Update:[/b] All enemy types using the shared logic have been updated to reflect the new detection system.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🛠️ Fixed an issue where some enemies failed to register overlapping players due to cast errors in the Level Blueprint.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ Optimized trigger communication between level scripts and AI Blueprints to prevent silent failures.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ Minor cleanup and performance improvements in enemy behavior scripts.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Dev Note:[/b] This update focuses on improving enemy responsiveness and reliability in co-op scenarios. Expect more polish and creepier AI behavior coming soon 👀[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – June Update
notes.content: [h3]🔄 New Feature: Revive System[/h3][p]You asked for it, and it’s here. Players can now revive their teammate during certain critical moments. Use this wisely; some things in [i]Spectral Protocol[/i] only give you one second chance.[/p][p][/p][h3]☠️ More Traps – "The Forgotten Dungeon"[/h3][p]The dungeon grows more dangerous. Additional traps have been added throughout [i]The Forgotten Dungeon[/i] level. Keep your eyes open and your steps precise — one wrong move can be your last.[/p][p][/p][h3]👣 Monster AI Navigation Fix – "The Forgotten Dungeon"[/h3][p]The creature that stalks the dungeon has received improved pathfinding. It’s faster, smarter, and more relentless. If you thought you were safe before... think again.[/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ Bug Fix: Stubborn Door[/h3][p]A critical issue where a certain door refused to open has been resolved. Your path is now clear… though you may wish it wasn’t.  Let us know what you think and keep sending your feedback. More updates are coming soon.[/p][p]Stay alert, _ [i]Neva Studio[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🧪 New Area Unlocked – Level 12: The Forgotten Dungeon 🕯️
notes.content:
A brand-new section has been added to Spectral Protocol. This time, you’ll descend into a dark, ancient dungeon buried beneath the testing grounds. Heavy stone, distant echoes, and flickering lights set the tone for one of the most atmospheric levels yet.

🗝️ What’s new:

A completely new map inspired by gothic catacombs and forgotten temples. Tight corridors, vertical layers, and candlelit halls await.

Your objective: find and activate four hidden levers to unlock the exit. But something else is wandering these halls…

Designed for duo play. Cooperation is key to survive and escape.

Fully optimized with improved distance culling for smoother performance and deeper immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577690/62c83d2544c63bc454523d730744d0d1cb1bc676.jpg[/img]

⚠️ Don’t trust the silence. In this place, it listens.

notes.title: Update v0.32m0.7
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[i]– Fixed an issue where the Settings menu would not open properly after accessing the Audio tab.
– Fixed a widget layering issue when opening both the Settings menu and Notes at the same time.
– Fixed a bug in the Hospital Level where the enemy would stop chasing the player.[/i]

[b]Gameplay Balancing[/b]
[i]– Increased the movement speed of all enemies.
– Added more enemies per player to raise the overall challenge.[/i]

[b]New Mechanics[/b]
[i]– Introduced a flashlight battery system.
– Added new UI elements for stamina and flashlight battery.[/i]
